snippet.title: Come To An End Demo Trailer 1 - Steam Launch
snippet.description:
What Is This Game?

This game is called "Come To An End", a horror labyrinth speed runner. You play as a game developer hobbyist making a retro dungeon horror labyrinth game called "The End". You designed an AI protagonist named "The Announcer". The Announcer was meant to be a boss that generates unique boss fights for each floor for the dungeons. You decided to delete the code for The Announcer and began to work on a less complex system for the boss battles. You later notice something weird going on with your code, it began to rewrite itself. In a panic, you try to exit the program but to no avail. Thinking of no other way to stop this chaos, you tried to turn off the computer. As you reached for the power button, your monitor began to glow with a bright orange vortex pulling you into the game.

Steam Page (Wishlist Now!): https://store.steampowered.com/app/3736600/Come_To_An_End/
